text: US Army training texts give simple rules for when the next key letter comes into use: run lengths from letter values, a counting expansion, overlapping windows of the word, restarts at a chosen letter, digits of a fraction. Each needs only a word and a rule.
Every rule with every dictionary word on the sculpture's tables, or with the word's letters left unknown, against the 24 known letters and ten scrambled copies.
No word fits any word rule; the restart and fraction rules fit K4 never, or no more often than the copies. Closed.
